_doc: Reference data for benchmarking the Castor pipeline against a cloud-native EHR/practice-management B2B SaaS for independent medical practices.

venture_under_test.name: Carepath
venture_under_test.description: Carepath is a cloud-native Electronic Health Record (EHR) and practice-management B2B SaaS for independent primary-care, urgent-care, and specialty medical practices with 5-50 providers. We bundle EHR, e-prescribing, billing, patient portal, and telehealth in one product priced at $250 per provider per month. Target buyer: Practice Owner / Medical Director and Practice Administrator at independent practices not yet absorbed into hospital systems. We compete with athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen Healthcare, Allscripts, and DrChrono. Differentiation: HIPAA-native cloud architecture (vs legacy on-prem retrofits), AI-driven SOAP-note generation from voice recording, and transparent flat-rate pricing without per-feature add-ons or hidden implementation fees.
venture_under_test.category: B2B SaaS healthcare / EHR for independent practices

expected_pipeline_outputs._tam_note: Defensible US ambulatory EHR scoping: narrow $0.5-1.5B (independent practices 5-50 providers, the ICP slice), mid-narrow $2-4B (full ambulatory cloud EHR), broad $5-8B (ambulatory EHR + e-prescribing + practice management). Pipeline TAM mid acceptable in $0.5B-$8B range.
